Game Overview

In Shark Escape, the core idea is straightforward: dive into an underwater thrill ride in Shark Escape. Navigate dangerous seas swarming with relentless sharks as you deftly steer your ship to safety. Upgrade your vessel, improve your lifepoints, and perfect your timing to master this addictively challenging quest for the highest score.
